selected_problem: Fresh canonical main fail-closes when a persisted run's id or protocol is externally rewritten, but RunStore.update itself still accepted patches that changed id or protocol and then durably wrote a document that the same store would reject on the next read.（最新规范主仓已经会在读取时拒绝被外部改写 id 或 protocol 的持久化 run，但 RunStore.update 自身仍允许补丁改写 id 或 protocol，并把一个下一次读取时会被同一存储拒绝的文档持久化。）
decision_basis: This is a direct write-side contradiction against the existing durable id/protocol read boundary, not a new storage architecture or migration policy.（这是对既有持久化 id/protocol 读取边界的直接写入侧矛盾，不涉及新的存储架构或迁移政策。）
TaskStore already follows the same principle that a public write API must not create state its own read path classifies as corrupt.（TaskStore 已采用相同原则：公开写 API 不应制造自身读取路径会判损坏的状态。）
changes: Reject update patches that attempt to change a run id to a different durable identity with RUN_ID_IMMUTABLE.（拒绝试图把 run id 改成不同持久化身份的更新补丁。）
Reject update patches that attempt to change the declared run protocol away from the current v0.2 contract with RUN_PROTOCOL_IMMUTABLE.（拒绝试图把声明协议改离当前 v0.2 契约的更新补丁。）
Keep normal status and metadata updates unchanged.（保持正常状态与元数据更新行为不变。）

verification.pre_fix_reality_replay: FAIL as expected: 0/2; both id and protocol rewrite probes were accepted instead of throwing（修复前按预期失败：0/2，id 与 protocol 改写探针均被错误接受）
verification.post_fix_reality_replay: PASS: 2/2; divergent id and protocol writes fail closed and the durable run remains readable under its original identity（修复后 2/2 通过；不同 id 与 protocol 的写入失败关闭，原持久化身份保持可读）

truth_boundary: This prevents RunStore.update from self-corrupting the already-declared durable run id/protocol identity. It does not authenticate coherently rewritten storage, define protocol migration, or make all run fields immutable.（本轮只防止 RunStore.update 自行破坏既有持久化 run 的 id/protocol 身份；不认证可一致改写的存储，不定义协议迁移，也不把所有 run 字段设为不可变。）
